cast.characterName: アナスタシア・リンゼル
cast.originalCharacterName: アナスタシア・リンゼル

segments.text: “I won't give up on myself ever again.”
Crimson Soul on the Wheel of Fortune

A girl who has had to deal with her stepmother's cruelty since childhood. A musty attic room was once her whole world, but that all changed when she gained the ability to change the past with the Fatal Rewind.
This unusual ability dyes her fate crimson and raises the curtain on a new manner of tragedy.
From Voltage Inc.

cast.characterName: ルーシェン・ノイシュバーン
cast.originalCharacterName: ルーシェン・ノイシュバーン

segments.text: “My promise with you has kept me alive.”
Transformed Azure with a Frail Heart

The kindly third-born prince of the Kingdom of Hystorica. Due to his mother's low standing, he's been tormented by relatives for most of his life. Though he's one of the few contenders for the throne, his weak nature means few expect much out of him. After the heroine's first Fatal Rewind, however, that's all turned on its head. He becomes a capable, if callous, public figure.
What changed him, and which of these personas is the real him? The heroine's time-changing powers give her frustratingly little insight.
From Voltage Inc.

cast.characterName: クライオス・キャソロック
cast.originalCharacterName: クライオス・キャソロック

segments.text: “Whatever decision you're faced with, I know the path you choose is the correct one.”
Heartless Charity and Greedy Affection
The young vice commander of the Wings of Garuda, an order that cares for the Goddess's favored birds.

His good looks, gentlemanly conduct, and refreshing smile have made him popular with the ladies. This popularity combined with the kind of personality that slips through your fingers earns him the ire of many a man, but his subordinates have nothing but trust for their vice commander.
He looks all but perfect on the surface, but dig a little deeper and you'll find an endless void.
From Voltage Inc.

cast.characterName: ティレル・I・リスター
cast.originalCharacterName: ティレル・I・リスター

segments.text: “If you want to scream, I'll take you back to a special room. We have whips, guillotines, and even cucking stools... Pick your poison.”
Sage of Integrity, Envoy of Misery

A preeminent inquisitor who condemns witches and their crimes. His polished looks and exceptional powers of deduction would earn him many fans were it not for the bitter scoldings he's so wont to give out. The snap of his whip only makes him that much more imposing, so many people find him hard to approach. As a result, Crius and Zenn are his only friends.
He has an unbending will and an incorruptible sense of justice, but an invisible collar still digs into his neck.
From Voltage Inc.

cast.characterName: ゼン・ソルフィールド
cast.originalCharacterName: ゼン・ソルフィールド

segments.text: “Your blade'll never land a fatal blow on me. ...Wanna give it a try anyway?”
The Isolated Hanged Man

A man whose family, birthplace, and even age remain shrouded in mystery. His large build and naturally fierce expression often inspire fear in others despite his own intent. Even his status as friend or foe remains entirely unknown to the heroine.
To understand just who Zenn is, she must make him an ally... but to make him in ally, she must expose his true identity.
From Voltage Inc.
“It is my duty to serve. But know that I am not robbed of my freedom. I choose who my master is.”
Blossom of Fidelity and Devotion
A maid in the Lynzel household. As the heroine's birth mother saved her when she was much younger, she remains incredibly devoted to her.
Though soft around the edges, she has a strength of spirit and a stubborn personality. Her calm smile hides beneath it a storm of emotions.
From Voltage Inc.

cast.characterName: コンラッド・ノイシュバーン
cast.originalCharacterName: コンラッド・ノイシュバーン

segments.text: “I'll do all I can to protect you. May you find solace in these arms.”
Domineering Sun

The promising first-born prince of the Kingdom of Hystorica. He easily garners the adoration of others through his florid style and lively personality. He tries to act with honor in all that he does, and many consider him the rightful candidate for the throne. He is the heroine's greatest ally and supporter.
From Voltage Inc.

cast.characterName: パーカー・ノイシュバーン
cast.originalCharacterName: パーカー・ノイシュバーン

segments.text: “My brother here believes in you from the bottom of his heart. How could I not give you the same courtesy?”
Gilded Jewel Sword

The arrogant second-born prince of the Kingdom of Hystorica. He's a selfish and haughty sort. Though his mother's high standing in the nobility gives him relative freedom, he's not exactly well liked. Though he's as eligible for the throne as his brothers, he's chosen to support Conrad, believing him to be the most worthy. Incidentally, the three brothers all have different mothers.
From Voltage Inc.

cast.characterName: エヴェリーナ・リンゼル
cast.originalCharacterName: エヴェリーナ・リンゼル

segments.text: “Repent that you continue to live today. Atone for the sin of living until tomorrow.”
Puppeteer of Fragile Hearts

The second wife of Marquess Lynzel and the king's younger sister. Her golden locks and a visage that brings to mind a flower in full bloom strike all those that see her speechless. She radiates an indescribable aura, but underneath the beautiful exterior is a black heart. She is a cruel and merciless sadist.
From Voltage Inc.
“I am your greatest ally, dear sister. You need only to trust in me.”
A Lonely Pixie Singing of Love

The heroine's stepsister and Evelina's daughter. Her adorable countenance inspires a desire to protect in others, and her natural charm makes her all the more likable. Both inside and out, she resembles her mother not one bit. Her hobby is interior decorating—she'd rather dress up a room than dress up herself.
From Voltage Inc.

cast.characterName: ヒューゴ・スペンサー
cast.originalCharacterName: ヒューゴ・スペンサー

segments.text: “If I want to be like the man I admire, then I must become a full-fledged knight.”
Devoted and Defeated

A cadet in the Wings of Garuda. Serious and disciplined, his admiration for Crius led to him choosing the path of a knight. Due to his father's profession as a cardinal, he earnestly looks after others. He's normally level-headed, but a single misstep can also lead to some unpredictable behaviors.
From Voltage Inc.

cast.characterName: ミッチェル・ホワード
cast.originalCharacterName: ミッチェル・ホワード

segments.text: “Everyone wants to be rich, but with money comes corruption. Aiming for the rank just below 'rich' is the best of both worlds.”
Greed is the Greatest Ally
A cadet in the Wings of Garuda.

This petit son of a merchant isn't really fit for knighthood, but his intelligence and worldly wisdom have helped him carve out his own unique space in the Wings. He makes a slight profit by selling prints of Crius on the side.
From Voltage Inc.
“Maya made this herself?! Ahh, even if this was my very last meal I could die happy!”
The Line Between Love and Obsession
A cadet in the Wings of Garuda.
Though his careless air and penchant for laziness make him seem ill-fit for the work of a knight at first glance, he's incredibly nimble and has even quicker reflexes.
He nurses feelings for Maya, but because she continues to brush him off he's yet to succeed at inviting her on a date.
From Voltage Inc.
“We haven't seen each other in some time. How are you?”
Eccentric and Hysteric
A court painter in direct service of the royal family.
His extraordinary talents have earned him many fans, all of whom will extol his skills with the arts.
His elusory nature, though, means he often doesn't appear in public. Very few have met him in person.
From Voltage Inc.
“If you want to change your fate, then I can help.”
Beloved Pet on the Shores of Death

A mysterious boy who lives in Elysia, a world apart from our own. A self-professed witch, he gifts the heroine with the Fatal Rewind ability. This cheery, affable youth seems to be on the heroine's side, but he still has his secrets...
From Voltage Inc.
“Now, let us begin this most frenzied of witch trials!”
Frenzy of Fury and Loathing

A witch who brings ruin to all, and Rune's enemy. He bequeaths incredible powers to people and enjoys watching the subsequent discord and suspicion they cause among other humans. He's unscrupulous and deranged, sadistic and cold-blooded. And no one knows what, exactly, he wants.
His real name is Ish.
From Voltage Inc.
From Voltage Inc.
The Marquess of Lynzel and Anastasia's father. After his wife Leticia died, he married Evelina.
"Ninja's my savior!"
Zealous Monomaniac
He was worked to the bone at his first job but was saved by the chivalrous thief Ninja from dying by overwork.
He subsequently became one of his biggest fans. As a result of his nighttime searches for his idol, though, he tends to doze during work.
From Voltage Inc.
"We are the Goddess's proxy. It is we who dole out justice."
Hollow Gaze
A member of the Nornan faith's College of Cardinals.
Though he's adroit at capturing the citizens' hearts through his sermons, he often throws his weight around and speaks in a condescending tone.
He has an eye for beauty, especially paintings (doubly so if they're of beautiful women).
A devoted fan of the genius painter Mael Diaz.
From Voltage Inc.
"Yeah I like stew... What about it?"
The Dreaming Chef
A young boy that lives in an orphanage after his parents' death. Though timid and very wary, he admires and adores Lucien due to latter's kind treatment of him.
He dreams of being a chef.
From Voltage Inc.
"...Frankly, I'm a lot more terrified of Inquisitor Lister than I am of the royal family."
The Runaway Quill
A reporter for the gossip mag, The Hideout News.
He tends to write from the perspective of the poor, and often chases after scandals involving the royalty and nobility.
Though spirited and amicable, he was previously arrested due to his particularly extreme methods of collecting information.
From Voltage Inc.

cast.characterName: ジェームズ・ノイシュバーン
cast.originalCharacterName: ジェームズ・ノイシュバーン

segments.text: "And does your soul know of the true history?"
A Crown of Pebbles
The current king of Hystorica.
He ascended to the throne after a struggle for power against his own siblings.
He has the dignified presence befitting a scion of the Goddess, but in reality he's a coward.
He also harbors a significant secret.
From Voltage Inc.
